en.title: Enterprise managed settings enforcement updates
en.summary: Enterprise administrators can now require supported GitHub Copilot clients to retrieve current server-managed settings at startup instead of relying on a cached policy.
en.details:
Enterprise administrators can now require supported GitHub Copilot clients to retrieve current server-managed settings at startup instead of relying on a cached policy. We are also adding minimum client version requirements to governance-focused managed settings keys over time, starting with the sandbox key.

Force refresh settings on client startup

Set forceRemoteSettingsRefresh to true through server-managed, MDM-managed, or file-based settings when a policy change must take effect before Copilot starts. The setting is supported in Copilot CLI, VS Code, and the GitHub Copilot app.

MDM-managed and file-based delivery can require freshness before the client signs in for the first time. A server-managed value begins requiring refreshes on subsequent startups after the client has received it once. While the setting is active, a cached response cannot satisfy the freshness requirement. If the client cannot confirm current policy, it fails closed rather than running with a stale or unconfirmed policy. Without this setting, clients continue to use the normal managed-settings cache for faster startup and resilience during transient service failures.

en.title: NVIDIA Announces New Investments in France’s Startups
en.summary: Companies in France are deploying agentic computing across industries spanning space, financial services, the public sector and scientific research, demonstrating how the country’s ecosystem has moved from ambition to application.
en.details:
Companies in France are deploying agentic computing across industries spanning space, financial services, the public sector and scientific research, demonstrating how the country’s ecosystem has moved from ambition to application.

France’s progress sits on deliberate groundwork.

The AI Action Summit in February 2025 and Choose France Summits in 2025 and 2026 anchored major compute commitments on French soil. What the ecosystem has built since then spans the full stack.

Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements

NVIDIA’s Investments in France

NVIDIA has been investing in France’s startup ecosystem, having previously invested in leading technology companies including Alice&Bob, Gradium and Scintil Photonics .

Across all of Europe, NVIDIA has committed nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem.

Today, NVIDIA announced new planned investments in Doctolib, Entalpic , Genesis AI and Pigment .

These startups are innovating to solve challenges across healthcare, materials discovery, physical AI and business planning.

Doctolib , a European healthcare technology company, builds agents that free up healthcare professionals to deliver better care, while providing patients with a digital health companion that improves access to care and supports more preventive, continuous medicine. …
